title: Repeater controller configuration and status
description: Proposed repeater-controller JSON contract. Root site holds defaults and shared equipment; root nodes maps any JSON string to a named controller with explicit site inheritance.
$comment: This is a proposed contract, not an implemented REST API. Local controller keys are arbitrary exact JSON strings under /nodes; friendly name metadata is not inherited and does not identify a network account. Site inherit_from is null; each controller inherit_from is site. Stored partial patches may omit existing metadata, while materialized scope definitions require explicit name and inherit_from. Resolve built-in defaults -> site -> controller, then validate references, interface capabilities, exclusive ownership and every affected configuration atomically. Arrays/scalars replace, named maps merge by key, mailbox identities shadow atomically across scopes, source changes clear obsolete pin/scancode fields, and source.type changes replace endpoint bindings. Shared site equipment runs once through its existing owner. AllStarLink, EchoLink, Proxy and phone-patch passwords use the same private credential store and credentials write/readback shape. A secret is bound to its protocol endpoint and account identity: a changed endpoint/account cannot automatically reuse an inherited secret for a different identity; require a matching local credential or report unconfigured. Passwords are never returned, including direct secret-path queries, errors and warnings. Redact resolved credentials before pointer projection. Omitted same-scope password is unchanged; empty string clears it and masks an inherited credential for that scope. Metadata and credentials are handled explicitly during inheritance. Timings stay in timing objects; RF uses MHz, audio/CTCSS uses Hz. Three-band compressor/multiband_limiter and final peak_limiter are fixed structural choices. Interface sensors consume live typed observations, preserving quality/time and normalizing Boolean values to 0/1 before calibration. No deletion/reset syntax is defined. Source baseline: https://github.com/cpeter1207/rpt_advanced/blob/b244eb17cf96ca839c92125f9062f34f03f644bd/doc/configuration.md . Validate every resolved command object against #/$defs/effectiveCommandSettings before activation; effective command macros require actions. Public query projections use sparse publicCommandSettings/commandMacro so a projected field need not repeat the full macro. All application message values remain one string and reuse the existing Fluent catalog plus checked media compositor. Flat Fluent arguments are bound from approved playback snapshots through existing Number/Forms preparation. Top-level unqualified message references are compositor operations; native Fluent attribute references retain explicit .text/.tts/.morse semantics. JSON locales compile into existing bundles without replacing FTL assets or fallback. No new template engine or encoded-media output adapter is required. Retain 127-byte ordinary rendered parts and existing checked compound bounds, complete Morse substitution, localized unavailable readings and private reply/routing rules. Never reinterpret formatted output as message references, commands or templates. Event schedules use hron via a separate versioned librptadvschedule recurrence descriptor. Retain released ABI1 civil/window behavior, serialized EventScheduler reservations, no catch-up, generation fencing and monotonic deadlines. Event timing. Legacy window timing is no longer canonical; unified events use start/end at expressions.  An omitted expression zone is bound explicitly to host-local IANA identity before evaluation; native hron UTC/gap-shift defaults do not silently change the compatibility policy. Link-window authoring now uses start/end groups with at, politeness_minutes, macro and warnings[{at,macro}]. This supersedes deferred legacy window authoring; remote_node/group_name and the former timing/warning_message fields are removed from windows only. Each boundary retries every minute through at+politeness_minutes inclusive and, once admitted, suppresses remaining attempts. Its final attempt bypasses inactivity, not macro authorization or runtime safety. Separate implementation design is still needed for recurrence pairing, overlapping phases, cold-start reconciliation and permanent-group route ownership. Latest scheduler contract supersedes earlier point-event/window split: schedule.events is the single event namespace, with effective start required and end optional. Canonical event bodies expose start/end directly; configuration and type wrappers are absent. Point payload/media settings move to named messages and command macros. Single-date hron expressions remain supported as ordinary start expressions. Event restart_recovery is a boolean, proposed default false. True requires an effective end and deliberately re-invokes the start macro once per controller start and active occurrence after safe activation. Do not confuse a controller-process restart with a configuration reload, and never use prior start admission to suppress the requested recovery invocation. Startup/permanent-link revision: controller_start is a reserved start.at value, not hron grammar, and end is disallowed. Add optional sequence_number with no numeric default and same-instant completion ordering. Add typed connect_permanent, pause_permanent_links, resume_permanent_links and call_macro actions mapped to existing handlers/executor. Preserve existing LinkManager network-outage retry behavior; startup creates/restores intent, it does not poll/reimplement reconnection. Complete command audit at rpt_advanced8188d5f0e6a738ac38e04e6fea2ba64c150e5ce9: controllerAction unifies all28LinkAction and27RemoteCommand variants, six site variants, maintenance/query/management and classified source-only entries. runtimeCommand and commandMacroAction reuse the catalog. Existing source/capability/lease restrictions, secret non-return and outage recovery remain enforced. Unified DTMF/action revision: mappings is a named map of flat canonical action fields plus command and protected. trigger/protected fields are removed from named macro definitions; aliases use call_macro. Canonical runtime/macro actions remain strict. DTMF input profiles reference the same action property schemas while existing handler decoders supply supported missing fields from the raw tail. No interpolation, implicit terminator, hidden prefix or persisted credential inputs. Generic parameter revision: every canonical action accepts parameter text; former target_node fields/requirements are renamed parameter with destination validation left to the handler. DTMF bindings do not persist parameter: the dispatcher supplies the complete unchanged raw tail up to the actual terminator, including empty/leading-zero input. Fixed parameters belong in macro/runtime actions. Credential action parameters remain write-only and are forbidden in authored macros. Sparse bindings defer cross-field completion checks until effective validation. Single-terminator revision: command.terminator is exactly one DTMF symbol, default#. Receipt evaluates the complete prior buffer and clears it; unmatched/empty/overflowed candidates are silently discarded. Eligible unkey and inactivity also complete candidates; end of an injected string alone never does. Old command.termination and commandTermination are removed; maximum_digits is retained as a separate sibling buffer limit. Completion correction: ordinary eligible RF unkey and inactivity also evaluate pending DTMF. command.inactivity_timeout_ms is a positive scalar sibling of terminator/mappings, default3000 matching current hardcoded code, not an existing nativeconfig setting. Keep per-source scope, real clock/deadline invalidation and no fabricated# for nonliteral completions. execute_dtmf may wait for inactivity within its total budget. DTMF source reconciliation at currentmain8188d5f0e6a738ac38e04e6fea2ba64c150e5ce9:26core+51explicitradio forms(35fixed,16parameterized), covering27radio variants, plus existinggenericradiofallback amongcore. Parrot/EchoTelemetry defaultprotected reflects intrinsicadmincheck; radio false retains per-operation provideraccesspolicy. Add positive inactivity_timeout_ms3000scalar and restoreeligibleRF/unkey/inactivity completion. Phone/jitter revision: remove phone allowed local/remote node lists and exposed max attachment/reverse-call controls, remove old tx/keying_mode controls, and reuse vad with phone-context enabledcontinuous defaults and shared hang timing. Shared jitter.timing(minimum_ms,initial_ms,maximum_ms) is referenced by phonePatch/EchoLink/AllStarLink and public profiles. Phone end-to-end latency stays in timing; phone check_deadline_ms removed and DTMF uses effective command.inactivity_timeout_ms without a copied timeout. RX-mute revision: newrx_mute_toggle targetsport/peer/peers(link_typeallstarlink|echolink)/phone_patch; default*99phoneonly. Mute gates received audioANDkeying after other qualifiers, retainsDTMF/control, usesliveingressbits and noqueuedreplay. Phonekeying_mode removed; VADoff usesotherqualifiers orcontinuousphone/SSBreception. SharedVADshape/genericparameter maintained. Controller storage/input policy: rpt_advanced accepts modular JSON only; remove its INI reader/importer/reconstruction/original-source forwarding. USBRadioPlus public INI format remains supported by that project; provider preparation uses a checked typed boundary for controller consumers. Implementation instruction 2026-11-19: unknown configuration keys and unknown/invalid/unsupported setting values are logged as value-free warnings and ignored using inherited/default settings. Canonical schemas describe normalized accepted/output values; syntax, duplicate-member ambiguity, operation structure, preconditions and unsafe relationships remain errors when no safe deterministic result exists.

nodeId.description: Remote network node identity as decimal digits; independent of the local controller name.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string selects the whole public tree.

frequency.description: Whole hertz below Nyquist at 48000 Hz; deliberately tighter than the legacy numeric parser.

dcsCode.description: Octal code and normal/inverted polarity; provider validates supported codewords.

reserved.description: Reserved. No current generic binding configuration is defined.

query.description: Read effective configuration/status at these pointers. Root and parent queries also omit all secrets.

pin_hash.description: PHC: salt >=16 bytes, output 32 bytes, m=19456..65536 KiB, t=2..5, p=1..4; server validates these bounds.

mailbox.description: Partial update to a stored mailbox in one scope; that scope must contain a complete identity after the patch. During inheritance a node record shadows the complete site record, preventing a node identity from borrowing a site PIN hash.

name.description: Friendly display name, independent of the controller map key and network node number. It is scope-local and is not inherited.

inherit_from.description: Explicitly inherit configuration from the root site object.

nodeSet.description: Partial named-controller update. Patches may omit metadata already present in the stored scope. New materialized site/controller records require name and inherit_from. name and inherit_from are scope-local metadata and never merge from a parent. Built-in defaults -> site -> controller supplies effective settings. Named maps merge by key; arrays/scalars replace. A node mailbox shadows the complete site identity. Changing a signal source clears obsolete pin/scancode selections; changing source.type replaces that endpoint binding.

name.description: Friendly display name, independent of the controller map key and network node number. It is scope-local and is not inherited.

inherit_from.description: Explicitly inherit configuration from the root site object.

nodeSnapshot.description: Effective inherited controller settings and status. Credentials are redacted before selecting query paths.

enabled.description: Enable programmable rig control; node/radio audio enable settings remain independent.

memories.description: Ordered complete memory records; a set replaces the array. Memory number 1 is array element 0. Reordering changes memory numbers; validate startup and scan references after merging.

offset_magnitude_mhz.description: MHz with up to six fractional digits (1 Hz resolution).

radio.description: One radio per node. duplex_mode is the sole duplex setting. RF values are MHz and signal/audio frequencies are Hz. Dynamics always use three bands. The control and interface settings share the same radio owner.
radio.$comment: Validate physical ownership, RF limits, memory references, signaling capability and timing relationships after resolving site defaults and node overrides.

receive.description: Each enabled squelch/VAD/CTCSS/DCS qualifier must pass (AND). No enabled qualifiers means open receive while audio is enabled and the source is healthy. A missing/faulted required observation fails closed. Multiple pins within one qualifier use OR after inversion. Unsupported protocol combinations are rejected after inheritance.

vad.description: Shared VAD settings with phone-context default enabled continuous/1000ms hang. When enabled, voice admission qualifies the caller; when disabled, caller reception is continuous for a live usable call, subject to receiver mute and other applicable keying/safety gates. No separate keying_mode exists.

phonePatch.$comment: Design-only provider/routing integration remains unfinished. Phone provider credentials use the same password-write/password_configured-readback contract as AllStarLink and EchoLink. Mailboxes resolve separately by scope.
phonePatch.description: Phone-patch settings with shared VAD/jitter. VAD-disabled caller reception is continuous while live/usable unless muted. Runtime mute AND-gates audio and keying; DTMF control remains available. Use the owning port common inactivity timeout and existing private credential contract.

max_symbols.description: Maximum injected DTMF symbols across one invocation and all nested calls.

max_actions.description: Maximum expanded actions across one invocation, including nested macros, typed actions and pauses.

max_depth.description: Maximum nested macro depth including the initial macro. Nested calls do not reset any budget.

macro_limits.description: Whole-invocation budgets apply to all command macro callers, including the scheduler. The duration includes pauses, handler completion and inactivity-completion waits.

mappings.description: Complete default catalog:26 core mappings plus51 explicit radio forms. Radio family/aliases require an enabled effective shared-radio owner; protected=false retains operation-specific Open/Locked/Disabled and capability policy. No independent DTMF code is invented for typed-only all-link actions. New design default*99 is rx_mute_toggle against phone_patch only; it does not toggle the local RF receiver or network peers.

macros.description: Unified named action sequences, called by schedule boundaries, call_macro or a DTMF mapping. DTMF metadata belongs only to mappings.

maximum_digits.description: Candidate buffer bound excluding the terminator. Overflow invalidates the entire candidate; ignore its remaining symbols until terminator/eligible unkey/inactivity completion, then clear without dispatching a suffix.

commandSettings.description: Buffer DTMF until the configured single terminator, a real source unkey eligible under current source policy, or inactivity_timeout_ms. Evaluate and clear the whole candidate once, match the longest command, check protection and pass the remaining symbols unchanged as parameter. Silently discard noncommands; handlers own invalid/missing parameters.

actions.description: Ordered actions. A present array replaces the inherited array in full. The effective macro must contain at least one action.

commandMacro.description: One named ordered actions sequence. DTMF codes and lock-code protection live in mappings that use call_macro; the macro definition has no trigger or separate entry protection field. Sparse local overrides inherit; complete effective actions are nonempty. Caller/source authorization and nested execution budgets remain.

commandMacroAction.description: Macros reuse controllerAction, but cannot persist credentials or fabricate ingress/private-call/host lifecycle context. Other actions still need original source, capability, lease and coordinator admission. Bare lock revokes only the caller grant.

effectiveCommandMacro.description: Materialized macro profile, validated after sparse inheritance and default resolution.

sequence.description: Existing tone-sequence grammar; <=256 segments, <=120 seconds total; frequencies below 24000 Hz.
Existing tone-sequence grammar; <=256 segments, <=120 seconds total; frequencies below 24000 Hz.

fluentIdentifier.description: Public message ID or flat Fluent argument name. Resource UUIDs and local radio-port keys remain separate.

fluentPattern.description: Native Fluent text pattern, such as Connecting to node { $peer-node-number }. Native references in these patterns use explicit attributes, e.g. { peer-identity.tts }; Fluent does not implicitly switch reference attributes. Validate syntax with fluent-syntax/fluent-bundle, not a regex. Retain existing rendered UTF-8 byte and audience-form limits.

fluentMessageForms.description: Sparse localized .text/.tts/.morse overrides. Resolve each form independently through existing locale/English fallback. A newly materialized catalog entry needs every form required by its uses and complete Morse where existing policy requires it.

messageBindingSource.description: Approved public source in one playback-attempt snapshot. sensor:<id> and input:<id> are exact named sources. No arbitrary object traversal, credentials, environment or device I/O.

messageBindings.description: Flat Fluent argument name (without $) to approved runtime source. Preserve MessageArgument::Number/Forms and audience-specific formatting. Merge bindings for one native Fluent reference closure; conflicting sources for one argument are invalid. Independent compositor parts retain their own owner bindings.

messageTemplate.description: One Fluent-aware composition string compiled by the existing controller compositor. Literal text and { $flat-argument } use Fluent. A top-level unqualified { message-id } is a compositor reference that selects the named part and its appropriate text/tts/morse or media source; native Fluent patterns instead use explicit attribute references. No arrays, Upon tags, encoded media instructions or reparsing of formatted output.

sequence.description: Existing tone-sequence grammar; <=256 segments, <=120 seconds total; frequencies below 24000 Hz.

locales.description: JSON-authored localized Fluent forms keyed by canonical language ID, validated with unic-langid. Compile to the existing Fluent catalog in memory. Preserve installed FTL catalogs, admin overrides and per-attribute English fallback.

message.description: Named definition with one source form: locales for localized Fluent text; content for composition; or existing file/speech/Morse/tone media. Validate mutually exclusive payload forms after sparse inheritance, retaining renderer options and complete Morse fallback. ID is its Fluent-compatible map key; dtmf_id is only a DTMF alias.

sequence.description: Existing tone-sequence grammar; <=256 segments, <=120 seconds total; frequencies below 24000 Hz.

schedule.description: One events map contains start-only and optional-end events. All boundary and warning at strings are provider-validated hron expressions with explicit or prepared host-local zones. Each boundary checks politeness through its own B+P deadline; admitted macros suppress later attempts. Validate effectiveEvent, macro references and optional paired occurrences after inheritance. Legacy permanent groups remain separate for compatibility; no canonical windows collection or one-shot event type remains. start.at also accepts controller_start; this special trigger disallows end. Optional sequence_number orders same-instant macro execution; unnumbered work uses best-effort end-first selection.

hronExpression.description: Canonical event boundary or warning recurrence expression parsed with pinned hron 2.2.1, e.g. every weekday at 19:00 in America/Chicago. Validate the complete grammar and supported dates in the schedule provider; JSON Schema checks only the source shape. Optional in <IANA zone> overrides host-local timezone, which otherwise resolves explicitly during generation preparation. The controller compatibility policy skips nonexistent DST times, accepts the first repeated minute and never replays missed events. Persist this source string, not hron Schedule serde output. The reserved controller_start trigger is outside hron and is permitted only in start.at.

restart_recovery.description: If true, on a controller restart while an event occurrence is between start (inclusive) and nominal end (exclusive), invoke its start macro again after safe activation, even if it ran before the restart. Requires an effective end. Recovery is once per controller-start identifier and active event occurrence; it is not triggered by configuration reload. Recovery admission suppresses unadmitted ordinary-start work for the same occurrence in this controller run. Recheck active-window membership before admission and initial dispatch; expire pending recovery at end.

sequence_number.description: Optional ascending execution order among events sharing an owning controller and nominal scheduled instant. Lower explicit numbers run first. Omission has no numeric default; use best-effort ends-before-starts where explicit ordering does not constrain the result. Preserve order through politeness, queue waits and complete macro execution.

event.description: One scheduled-event shape: effective start is required and end is optional. Start-only and paired start/end events share the same boundary/warning/politeness logic. Omission of effective end means no closing action; hron still controls whether start repeats or occurs on a single date. Link operations and messages belong to command macros. Sparse local overrides are permitted; validate effective required fields and references after inheritance. Event resources expose start/end directly without a configuration wrapper. Optional restart_recovery defaults false; true re-invokes start once after a controller restart within its active window and requires an effective end. start.at=controller_start runs once after safe activation per controller start and disallows effective end and restart_recovery=true. sequence_number orders same-instant event work without assigning a number to omitted values.

remote_node.description: Priority order; index zero is highest.

status_message.description: One text-only Fluent-backed composition for station/profile status. Preserve locale fallback; reject references requiring file/tone playback.

echolink.description: EchoLink account. Account and optional Proxy passwords use the same private credential-store and public readback contract as other protocols.

processing.description: Optional source processing. Compressor and multiband_limiter always have three bands. Their defaults apply to all bands unless low/mid/high overrides them. peak_limiter has a fixed final position and is excluded from stage_order.

localProcessing.description: Local receiver source processing. Bandpass and CTCSS rejection operate before the fixed final peak limiter.

transmitProcessing.description: Voice/telemetry processing. Bandpass runs before the fixed final peak_limiter.

sequence.description: Existing tone-sequence grammar; <=256 segments, <=120 seconds total; frequencies below 24000 Hz.

frequency.description: Receive/base frequency in MHz, with 1 Hz resolution.

memory.description: One complete memory. RF frequency and offset magnitude use MHz; CTCSS tone frequencies use Hz. Array position determines the one-based memory number. Validate derived transmit frequency and RF limits after merging.

label.description: One text-only Fluent-backed composition for the spoken/display label. Localized named text is resolved through the existing catalog and its forms.

sensor.description: Source may be a live interface property. timing.stale_after_ms must exceed poll_interval_ms; two-point calibration requires distinct source endpoints. Share inherited site acquisitions rather than opening another interface. Boolean source values are normalized to 0/1 before calibration; invalid observations retain their quality and never become zero.

ptt_nodes.description: Local controller names from /nodes whose PTT activity controls the fan.

link_type.description: Actual network protocol namespace; independent of monitor/transceive/permanent/proxy state.

pins.description: Live parallel pin observations; unavailable readback is null with appropriate quality.

readings.description: Capability-reported live numeric audio/interface observations available to site references.

raw_input_report.description: Provider-specific raw input bytes; report length is not fixed.

input_mask.description: Backend GPIO bitmask; available pins are capability-reported.

pins.description: Live GPIO observations by provider pin identifier. value, quality and observation time are preserved for site references.

frequency_hz.description: CTCSS frequency in Hz; normalize the provider tenths-of-hertz representation.

rx_frequency_mhz.description: MHz with up to six fractional digits (1 Hz resolution).

anyOf.description: MHz with up to six fractional digits (1 Hz resolution).

tx_frequency_mhz.description: Transmit frequency in MHz; null means receive-only.

bandwidth_mhz.description: MHz with up to six fractional digits (1 Hz resolution).

rit_mhz.description: MHz with up to six fractional digits (1 Hz resolution).

operatingState.description: Requested, applied or measured radio operating state. All RF frequencies, bandwidth and signed offsets are MHz; CTCSS tone frequencies remain Hz.

set.description: Atomically patch site and named controllers, resolve explicit inheritance and validate every affected effective configuration. Local keys do not supply network node numbers.

serialInputPin.description: Computer/DTE inputs: CTS DB9 pin 8, DSR pin 6, DCD pin 1, RI pin 9. Wiring must expose the intended radio status.

serialOutputPin.description: Computer/DTE outputs: RTS DB9 pin 7, DTR pin 4. RIGblaster Advantage uses RTS for PTT; DTR may instead be CW/FSK on that model.

device.description: Serial endpoint, for example /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3.

serialDevice.description: Optional settings for the shared serial endpoint used by carrier/CTCSS inputs and PTT outputs. Configure pin arrays on each signal. New effective serial bindings need a device and supported pins. Flow control must not own those lines.
serialDevice.$comment: Pin directions and DB9 numbers: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/product-selector-card/rs232%20quick%20guide.pdf . RIGblaster PTT: https://www.westmountainradio.com/pdf/RB_Advantage_Manual.pdf and https://www.westmountainradio.com/pdf/nomicman4.pdf . Modem-line control and serial settings: https://pyserial.readthedocs.io/en/stable/pyserial_api.html . RXD/TXD carry serial data and are not Boolean control-pin selections. Adapter setup must release PTT outputs, including unused PTT-connected RTS/DTR lines, and coordinate access with CAT.

radioCommand.description: All27RemoteCommand operations plus planned structured state projection. RF values are MHz. set_frequency offset_direction chooses configured magnitude; explicit magnitude uses radio/set. Exact provider metadata, capability, source grants and TX safety remain authoritative.

frequency.description: Nonnegative offset magnitude in MHz. With plus, TX=frequency+offset; with minus, TX=frequency-offset. Disabled offset means simplex.
CTCSS tone in Hz, independently enabled for transmit and receive. The radio provider validates supported tones.

enabled.description: Enable de-emphasis for flat/discriminator input; disable for already de-emphasized input.
Enable receiver programme audio; signaling qualification retains its own policy.
Enable transmitter programme audio; signaling and PTT retain their own policy.

inverted.description: For each selected input: active = raw Boolean state XOR inverted; multiple active inputs are combined with OR.

scancode.description: Held-key observation on interface.keyboard.device. The Linux evdev backend uses decimal EV_KEY codes 1 through 767 from input-event-codes.h.

squelch.description: Carrier qualification. A sound-chip GPIO binding selects exactly one pin. Serial and parallel domains retain their supported pin arrays; normalize inversion before input aggregation. Resolve bindings after inheritance.

mode.description: When VAD is enabled, kerchunk admits after fresh speech until the independent closing qualifier; continuous follows speech plus hang. Disabled VAD does not close receive.

vad.description: Disabled VAD removes only the VAD qualification: use other enabled keying signals, or continuous reception when none apply (phone caller and ordinary SSB USB/LSB). Receiver mute always AND-gates the result. Enabled kerchunk needs an independent closing qualifier, otherwise normalize to continuous VAD with a warning; enabled continuous follows speech plus hang.

frequency_hz.description: Configured CTCSS frequency in Hz. The selected provider validates supported tones.

inverted.description: For every selected output: raw state = logical PTT XOR inverted.

scancode.description: Backend scan code; key_down requires this field. The selected keyboard backend defines the code set.

ptt.description: PTT binding. A sound-chip GPIO binding selects exactly one pin. Serial and parallel domains may drive their supported pin arrays together. key_down uses scancode instead of pin.

encoderOutput.description: External encoder-enable binding, used only while its protocol is enabled and selects an external source. Validate protocol capability and output ownership. Simultaneous encoders may not share an output unless the provider explicitly supports it; GPIO enable does not set frequency or deviation.

dtmfCommand.description: Complete DTMF command code. Any literal * is part of the code, not a prefix marker. Empty disables the inherited mapping. An effective nonempty mapping command cannot contain the configured terminator.

dtmfProtection.description: Require the actual originating source to have a valid lock-code administration grant before dispatching this DTMF mapping. False omits this additional entry gate; action/source/capability and safety permissions remain in force.

dtmfActionBindingShapes.description: Transport input projections over canonical action property schemas; sparse declarations may inherit static fields or bind supported arguments from the raw DTMF tail. This does not weaken concrete runtime/macro action requirements.

dtmfMapping.description: Flat action fields plus command and protected. parameter is runtime-supplied by DTMF and is not stored in this binding; use call_macro for a fixed parameter action. Canonical property schemas are shared. Sparse overrides may inherit static fields. Ephemeral administration codes/private PINs are excluded even from selector-less sparse JSON; hardware pin objects remain permitted.

effectiveDtmfMapping.description: Post-inheritance input profile: require action/command/protected, retain canonical effective cross-field rules and static fields unless the action DTMF decoder supplies them. Dispatcher always passes the raw tail as parameter, including empty input. Handler owns argument interpretation and responses. No decoder means static typed fields must be complete.

dtmfMappings.description: Named inheritable DTMF bindings with arbitrary stable keys. Each value is an action object plus command/protected. Duplicate effective nonempty codes are rejected; overlapping codes use longest match only after valid termination. Noncommands are silently ignored. Defaults include all51 existing remote-radio spellings/parameterized prefixes plus the26 core entries. Fixed forms require empty parameter; variable forms use the existing handler grammar. All radio entries, including fallback, are dormant when their shared-radio owner is absent/disabled. The additional designed*99 phone-patch RX-mute binding brings canonical defaults to78.

actionParameter.description: Generic text passed unchanged to the selected action handler. DTMF supplies the tail after the matched command and before termination, preserving empty input and leading zeros. Fixed macro/runtime values keep their own typed origin. Each handler decides whether/how to parse, require, reject or ignore it; it is not globally a node ID. Terminator, eligible source unkey and inactivity complete the candidate; for unkey/timeout the whole buffered remainder is passed, without adding a delimiter.

dtmfTerminator.description: One literal DTMF terminator, default#. Receipt evaluates the complete prior candidate and clears it. Real source unkey and configured inactivity also complete eligible candidates. The terminator itself is excluded from command/parameter. Empty/noncommand candidates are silently discarded. Unkey/timeout are distinct completion reasons, not injected # symbols.

dtmfInactivityTimeout.description: Milliseconds without another DTMF symbol before evaluating the pending candidate. The native code currently hardcodes3000ms; exposing this scalar is a new configuration contract. Use the actual source monotonic clock and rearm on each buffered digit. No symbols means no timer; any completed/retired candidate invalidates its stale timer. Recheck exact native integer range during preparation.

jitter.description: Shared network playout jitter settings for phone patch, EchoLink and AllStarLink. Milliseconds; after inheritance validate0<=minimum_ms<=initial_ms<=maximum_ms and transport capability/latency constraints. Sparse timing overrides inherit independently.

parameter.description: Optional exact live call_id returned by this owning port phone-patch status. Actual caller context takes precedence for caller-issued actions; omitted selection from a nonphone source requires a unique attached caller. Not a node number or mailbox identity.

receiveControlAction.description: Runtime receiver mute toggles both admitted PCM and receive keying for selected live ingress. Effective receive=normal qualified receive AND NOT muted. Control/DTMF and raw observations remain active; user-muted audio is drained, not replayed on unmute.

muted.description: Live per-ingress user RX mute. True suppresses this source audio and keying while retaining detector/DTMF/control observations.

active.description: Effective source receive/program activity after qualification and user mute.
